BURNINGMOD-TORCH_STRIKE.title: Torch Strike
BURNINGMOD-TORCH_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply {EnemyBurn:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to enemy and {SelfBurn:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to yourself.
BURNINGMOD-KINDLE.title: Kindle
BURNINGMOD-KINDLE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Apply {SelfBurn:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to yourself. When hit this turn, apply {ReturnBurn} [gold]Burn[/gold] to attacker.
BURNINGMOD-TORCHBEARER.title: Torchbearer
BURNINGMOD-TORCHBEARER.description: Add a random [gold]Torch[/gold] card to your hand. It costs 0 this turn. At the start of each turn, add another.
BURNINGMOD-TORCH_SWEEP.title: Torch Sweep
BURNINGMOD-TORCH_SWEEP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Apply {EnemyBurn:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies. Apply {SelfBurn:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to yourself.
BURNINGMOD-SEARING_BLOW.title: Searing Blow
BURNINGMOD-SEARING_BLOW.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Hit twice if enemy is [gold]Burning[/gold]. Hit thrice if you are also [gold]Burning[/gold].
BURNINGMOD-SMOLDERING_RAGE.title: Smoldering Rage
BURNINGMOD-SMOLDERING_RAGE.description: Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold]. Whenever [gold]Burn[/gold] is applied to you, apply [gold]Burn[/gold] equal to your [gold]Strength[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BURNINGMOD-PYROMANIAC.title: Pyromaniac
BURNINGMOD-PYROMANIAC.description: Gain {BaseStr:diff()} Strength. If [gold]Burning[/gold], gain {BurnStr:diff()} Strength and {BurnDex:diff()} Dexterity instead.
BURNINGMOD-IMMOLATION.title: Immolation
BURNINGMOD-IMMOLATION.description: Apply {SelfBurn:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to yourself. Deal your [gold]Burn[/gold] × {Multiplier:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Spread your [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies, then remove [gold]Burn[/gold] from yourself.
BURNINGMOD-CHARRED_HAND.title: Charred Hand
BURNINGMOD-CHARRED_HAND.description: Apply {BurnAmount} [gold]Burn[/gold] to yourself and draw 1 card{IfUpgraded:show:, twice|}. [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card in hand. If you have 3+ [gold]Burn[/gold], gain 1 Energy and [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
BURNINGMOD-MELTING_GUARD.title: Melting Guard
BURNINGMOD-MELTING_GUARD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If you have 2+ [gold]Burn[/gold], [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. On [gold]Exhaust[/gold], apply {ExhaustBurn:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies, then gain Block equal to total [gold]Burn[/gold] on all creatures.
BURNINGMOD-SCORCHED_EARTH.title: Scorched Earth
BURNINGMOD-SCORCHED_EARTH.description: Apply {BurnAmount:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies. Deal damage equal to one target's [gold]Burn[/gold].
BURNINGMOD-FORGED_IN_FLAME.title: Forged in Flame
BURNINGMOD-FORGED_IN_FLAME.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Burn[/gold] to yourself, gain {Amount:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold], {Amount:diff()} Block, and 1 [gold]Plating[/gold].
BURNINGMOD-EMBER.title: Ember
BURNINGMOD-EMBER.description:
On draw, apply 1 [gold]Burn[/gold] to a random enemy and yourself.
On play, apply 1 [gold]Burn[/gold] to yourself and {BurnAmount} [gold]Burn[/gold] to an enemy. If they have {BurnThreshold}+ [gold]Burn[/gold], draw 1 card.
BURNINGMOD-FIRE_BRAND.title: Fire Brand
BURNINGMOD-FIRE_BRAND.description:
Apply {VulnAmount:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Whenever [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] is applied to an enemy, also apply {BurnAmount:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold].
BURNINGMOD-THE_FINAL_TORCH.title: The Final Torch
BURNINGMOD-THE_FINAL_TORCH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply {EnemyBurn:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to enemy and {SelfBurn:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to yourself. Deals {IfUpgraded:show:+3|+2} damage and {IfUpgraded:show:+3|+2} [gold]Burn[/gold] per [gold]Torch[/gold] played this combat. [gold]Exhaust[/gold] all [gold]Torch[/gold] cards.
BURNINGMOD-BURNING_SHIV.title: Burning Shiv
BURNINGMOD-BURNING_SHIV.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply {BurnAmount} [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BURNINGMOD-EMBER_BLADES.title: Ember Blades
BURNINGMOD-CHAINED_FLAME.title: Chained Flame
BURNINGMOD-CHAINED_FLAME.description: Apply {WeakAmount:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to an enemy. Apply [gold]Burn[/gold] equal to their [gold]Weak[/gold] stacks.
BURNINGMOD-CINDER_TOSS.title: Cinder Toss
BURNINGMOD-CINDER_TOSS.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {BurnAmount} [gold]Burn[/gold] to a random enemy {HitCount:diff()} times.
BURNINGMOD-PHOSPHOR_BLADE.title: Phosphor Blade
BURNINGMOD-PHOSPHOR_BLADE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply {BurnAmount:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold]. If you've applied [gold]Burn[/gold] this turn, hit twice.
BURNINGMOD-SMOKE_AND_EMBERS.title: Smoke and Embers
BURNINGMOD-SMOKE_AND_EMBERS.description: Discard your hand. Apply {BurnPerCard:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies for each card discarded. Apply {WeakAmount:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to an enemy.
BURNINGMOD-ASH_CLOUD.title: Ash Cloud
BURNINGMOD-ASH_CLOUD.description: Apply {WeakAmount} [gold]Weak[/gold] and {BurnAmount} [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.{IfUpgraded:show: Apply twice.|}
BURNINGMOD-FIRE_DIP.title: Fire Dip
BURNINGMOD-FIRE_DIP.description: Add {ShivCount:diff()} [gold]Burning Shiv[/gold]s to your hand. This turn, your Attacks apply 2 [gold]Burn[/gold] to the target.
BURNINGMOD-CAUSTIC_FLAME.title: Caustic Flame
BURNINGMOD-CAUSTIC_FLAME.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Burn[/gold] to an enemy, also apply {PoisonAmount:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold].
BURNINGMOD-COMBUSTION_TRAP.title: Combustion Trap
BURNINGMOD-COMBUSTION_TRAP.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Apply 1 [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies. Next turn, apply {BurnAmount:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BURNINGMOD-ARSONIST.title: Arsonist
BURNINGMOD-ARSONIST.description: At the start of enemies' turns, they lose HP equal to their [gold]Burn[/gold] stacks. [gold]Burn[/gold] still ticks normally at end of their turn.
BURNINGMOD-DANCING_FLAME.title: Dancing Flame
BURNINGMOD-DANCING_FLAME.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {BurnAmount:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to a random enemy {HitCount:diff()} times. Hits an additional time for each time you applied [gold]Burn[/gold] this turn ([green]{BonusHits}[/green]).
BURNINGMOD-CREMATION.title: Cremation
BURNINGMOD-CREMATION.description: Exhaust a card from your discard pile. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {BurnAmount:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold]. Repeat for each Energy the exhausted card costs.
BURNINGMOD-TOXIC_EMBER.title: Toxic Ember
BURNINGMOD-TOXIC_EMBER.description:
On draw, apply 1 [gold]Poison[/gold] and 1 [gold]Burn[/gold] to random enemies.
Apply {PoisonAmount} [gold]Poison[/gold] and {BurnAmount} [gold]Burn[/gold] to an enemy.
BURNINGMOD-SMOLDERING_EDGE.title: Smoldering Edge
BURNINGMOD-SMOLDERING_EDGE.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Burn[/gold], [gold]Shiv[/gold]s deal 1 additional damage this turn. Resets each turn.
BURNINGMOD-BURNING_TOXIN.title: Burning Toxin
BURNINGMOD-BURNING_TOXIN.description:
If enemy has [gold]Poison[/gold], draw 1 card and gain 1 Energy.
Apply {PoisonAmount:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] and {BurnAmount:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold].
BURNINGMOD-ETERNAL_FLAME.title: Eternal Flame
BURNINGMOD-ETERNAL_FLAME.description: Apply {BurnAmount:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies. [gold]Burn[/gold] stacks no longer decrease.
BURNINGMOD-IGNITE.title: Ignite
BURNINGMOD-FOCUSED_FLAME.title: Focused Flame
BURNINGMOD-FOCUSED_FLAME.description: Gain {FocusAmount:diff()} [gold]Focus[/gold] this turn. Apply {BurnAmount:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to an enemy.
BURNINGMOD-HEAT_SINK.title: Heat Sink
BURNINGMOD-HEAT_SINK.description: Channel 1 [gold]Fire Orb[/gold]. Gain {Block:diff()} Block for each [gold]Fire Orb[/gold] channeled.
BURNINGMOD-SEAR.title: Sear
BURNINGMOD-SEAR.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply {BurnAmount} [gold]Burn[/gold]. Each Sear played increases [gold]Burn[/gold] by {Increase:diff()} this combat.
BURNINGMOD-FLASHPOINT.title: Flashpoint
BURNINGMOD-FLASHPOINT.description: The next {Amount:diff()} time(s) any Orb evokes, deal 3 damage and apply 3 [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BURNINGMOD-BURNOUT.title: Burnout
BURNINGMOD-BURNOUT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {BlockAmount:diff()} Block. Apply {BurnAmount:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold]. Add a [gold]Burn[/gold] into your Discard Pile.
BURNINGMOD-SCORCH_SELF.title: Scorch Self
BURNINGMOD-SCORCH_SELF.description: Replace ALL cards in your Draw and Discard Piles with [gold]Burn[/gold] status cards. Whenever you draw a [gold]Burn[/gold], Channel 1 [gold]Fire Orb[/gold] and gain 1 temporary [gold]Focus[/gold].
BURNINGMOD-THERMAL_SHIELD.title: Thermal Shield
BURNINGMOD-THERMAL_SHIELD.description: Gain {BlockAmount:diff()} Block. Shuffle 1 [gold]Burn[/gold] into your Draw Pile and 1 into your Discard Pile. Whenever you draw a [gold]Burn[/gold], gain {ShieldAmount:diff()} Block.
BURNINGMOD-FLARE.title: Flare
BURNINGMOD-FLARE.description: Channel 1 [gold]Fire Orb[/gold]. Draw 1 card for each [gold]Burning[/gold] enemy{IfUpgraded:show: +1|}.
BURNINGMOD-THREATENING_FLAME.title: Threatening Flame
BURNINGMOD-THREATENING_FLAME.description: Channel 1 [gold]Fire Orb[/gold] for each Attack in your hand.
BURNINGMOD-INFERNAL_OVERLOAD.title: Infernal Overload
BURNINGMOD-INFERNAL_OVERLOAD.description: Transform all [gold]Fire Orbs[/gold] into [gold]Inferno Orbs[/gold]. Whenever you Channel a [gold]Fire Orb[/gold], channel an [gold]Inferno Orb[/gold] instead.
BURNINGMOD-HEAT_TRANSFER.title: Heat Transfer
BURNINGMOD-HEAT_TRANSFER.description: Whenever you Channel an Orb, apply {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} [gold]Burn[/gold] to a random enemy.
BURNINGMOD-THAW.title: Thaw
BURNINGMOD-THAW.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Channel 1 [gold]Frost Orb[/gold]. At the start of your next turn, Evoke all [gold]Frost Orbs[/gold], then Channel 1 [gold]Fire Orb[/gold] for each evoked.
BURNINGMOD-KINDLING_CIRCUIT.title: Kindling Circuit
BURNINGMOD-KINDLING_CIRCUIT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Evoke your front orb. If the target is [gold]Burning[/gold], channel that orb again.
BURNINGMOD-RESONANT_FIELD.title: Resonant Field
BURNINGMOD-RESONANT_FIELD.description: Whenever you gain a power you don't already have, Channel 1 [gold]Fire Orb[/gold] and apply {BurnAmount} [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
